+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **A Theory of Economic Growth: Dynamics  | David de la Croix, Philippe Michel       | Book                             |
| and Policy in Overlapping Generations**  |                                          |                                  |
| (2002)                                   |                                          |                                  |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| A graduate textbook that develops the overlapping generations model with capital accumulation in a rigorous way. It    |
| covers the dynamics and stability of the Diamond model, optimality and dynamic efficiency, public debt, pensions and   |
| altruism.                                                                                                              |
